author: Giogex
quote:
There are a lot of issues. We waited 11 long years for this game, followed by another 2 years of delays because Rockstar Games promised to optimize it to avoid glitches and bugs. Launching with glitchy physics, random crashes after just a few hours of gameplay, and significant FPS drops, sometimes even after explosion scenes, is simply unacceptable. Rockstar Games has failed to deliver on its promises this time. It's not fair to treat the hundreds of thousands of players who have been waiting for this moment for over a decade this way. From a technical standpoint, the game is nowhere near where it should be. Without a doubt, it will set new standards for the future, but first, they absolutely need to fix all of these issues.
In my personal opinion, in 2026, having fewer than 60 FPS is absolutely unacceptable. For this reason alone, it doesn't deserve a 99/100. Other games have been heavily criticized for these exact same issues, while in this case, this aspect has been completely overlooked. It's a double standard that seems to favor Rockstar Games. Games like Cyberpunk 2077, Mass Effect Andromeda, Pokémon Scarlet and Violet, No Man's Sky, and Forspoken immediately come to mind, just to name a few. These games were heavily criticized for glitches, severe FPS drops, poorly expressive facial animations, lack of multiplayer, and shallow dialogue. At the moment, this is a game that simply isn't worth playing, as it fails to deliver the experience it should.

quote: Honestly, I don't think I could have asked for a better remake. Ocarina of Time was already an incredible game, but seeing it brought back to life like this is something truly special. The graphics are beautiful, the world feels so much more alive, and everything feels smoother and more enjoyable to play. The new camera and modernized controls make a huge difference, especially compared to the original.What surprised me the most is how well the game holds up even today. Exploring Hyrule, discovering new places, solving puzzles and getting lost in the adventure never felt boring. There's something about this game that modern titles sometimes struggle to capture, that feeling of genuinely wanting to see what's waiting around the next **** music is absolutely beautiful, the atmosphere is incredible, and the attention to detail throughout the entire game is amazing. You can tell how much care went into this remake.I don't want to spoil anything, but this is one of those games that makes you understand why people love Zelda so much. It's not just about nostalgia or making an old game look better. It's about taking an already legendary experience and making it feel fresh again.Nintendo absolutely nailed it.
